description: This file defines a custom matcher class `MacroCallParameterBooleanValueMatcher` used for testing purposes, specifically for matching boolean values in test assertions within the package related to the OFBiz widget renderer macro module.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterBooleanValueMatcher
classes.description: A custom hamcrest matcher for asserting boolean values in tests, encapsulating the expected boolean value and providing descriptive mismatch information.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterBooleanValueMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matcher with the expected boolean value.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the given object equals the expected boolean value.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Describes the matcher condition, including the expected boolean value.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Provides mismatch information, showing the actual boolean value received.
